stem:
Diya's kitchen science club mixes the same spoonful of curd starter into a jug of lukewarm milk and into a jug of cold milk. Both jugs sit overnight. Only the lukewarm milk sets into curd; the cold milk may taste a little sour but does not set the same way.

Which statements correctly explain the results?

statements.text: Lukewarm milk with starter sets into curd after some hours because the starter microbes work well at that warmth; cold milk with the same starter does not curdle in the same way.
Lukewarm milk turns into curd immediately when the starter is mixed in.
Both jugs have formed curd because both taste a little sour.

teacher.key_rationale: Curd forms in lukewarm milk with starter after hours; cold milk does not set the same way. Immediate setting and sour taste alone are not enough.
